content: Kiyaha ndundame nkulu ywohele ywakahaghulitwe mu anabhandu, aywo kabhikwa kwa kya bhandu mu milando yiibheghite ya Chgapanga, ngati kabhuhe nyambi na bhwengu kwa kya ulemwa.
Kya bhula aywo ndundame mwene kabhegha na uyoyobhalo, kaahotola kubhatendela kwa luhungu bhala bhaatenda ulemwa kyanga kumanya na bhanakutenda uhokelo,
Kwa kya agho, kangunoghwa kubhuha nyambi kwa kya ulemwa ghweka, ngati kwa kya ulemwa ghwa kya ywombe bhubho.
Na kahone mundu yunakulihaghula mwene kubhegha Ndundame, ngati kangukemwa na Chgapanga, handa bhula Aluni.
Ubhwabhu abhu Kilisito naywo kakilikweha ng'obhe mwene uhokamo ghwa kubhegha Ndundame Nkulu, peni Chgapanga kakinng'ombela,
Handa payityekitwe pamoo pangi mu Malembo,

content.text: kwa nnandano ghwa undundame ghwa Melikisedeki.”

content: Yesu pakabheghite na ubhumi pa nnima aghu, kakilila kwa lilobhe likulu na mahohi, kakinhokamila na kunnyupa Chgapanga ywakabheghite na makakala gha kunnopoha mu kiho, naywo Chgapanga kakinnyihwa Yesu kiyaha kakibha yunakutundamila muulongolo ghwake.
Hata pakabhele kakibhegha Mwana ghwa Chgapanga, peni kakilihunda kuyitikila mu njila ya himbamanda.
Naywo pakatwihilihitwe kala kakibhegha nhokolo ghwa ulopoho ghwa manjubha ghoha kyanga uhiko kwa bhandu bhaannyitikila,
Mbole Chgapanga kakinninga kubhegha ndundame nkuluhanda pakabheghite Melikisedeki.
Tubhegha na malagho matangalo gha kubhaghombela kwa kya undundame ghwa Yesu, peni ndo unonopo kualubhulila kiyaha munakutopa bha kumanya.

Kiyaha mu manjubha agha yinguibhanogha kubhegha ahunda, peni nkali mungunoghwa kubhegha na mundu ghwa kuahunda mahundo gha kandahi ya lilagho lya Chgapanga. Mungunoghwa kunywegha mabhele kihyengo kya hilyo hinonopo.
Ywohele ywakanoghwa kuyonga mabhele ndo kakali mwana king'enya, mana aywo kangumanya ng'obhe ghamaha na mahakata.
Peni bhandu bhaalyegha hilyo hinonopo ndo akamala kala, mana bhaahunditwe kwa mandendelo kufwambula umaha na uhakata.
